sloka: अनिलश्चानलश्चैव हरः सम्पातिरेव च ।एते विभीषणामात्या मालेयास्तु निशाचरः ।। ७.५.४४ ॥
transliteration: anilaścānalaścaiva haraḥ sampātireva ca ।ete vibhīṣaṇāmātyā māleyāstu niśācaraḥ ।। 7.5.44 ॥

translations.english: Anila, Anala, Hara, and Sampati are these sons of Mali, who were night-wanderers and later became ministers of Vibhishana.
